title: Add-Expense-VAT-settings-to-Contoso-demo-tool
summary: The Expense Agent Contoso demo data now includes expense VAT settings. G/L account demo data was added and registered in the Expense Agent Contoso module and country data, and the Create Expense VAT Rates codeunit was substantially reworked.
key_points: Expense VAT settings added to the Contoso demo tool for the Expense Agent
New G/L account demo data added to the setup data
Expense Agent Contoso module and country data updated to include the new setup
Create Expense VAT Rates and Create Expense Categories codeunits reworked
Some Shopify test codeunits were also modified
